text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0840 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne down on CBOT calls and rain on Canada's Prairies. Technical support seen in the July at C$394, C$390 and C$389 with resistance at C$400, C$402 then C$403.80. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -0.02 Thursday from -1.69 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3873 to the U.S. dollar, rose to 82.54 yen, rose to 1.2441 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 up on UGG short covering in the July as elevators offer premiums of C$8-C$10 a tonne over July futures.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to continue selling July and spreads with technical support seen in the low C$120s in July.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls and wet weather in northern Alberta.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
